locations.name: Msasa Freight Yard
locations.description: A freight and customs yard east of the city centre. Containers, floodlights, a weighbridge and a small administration block. Nightjar uses bay six for cargo that never appears on a manifest.

routes.name: Front gate
routes.description: Lit, staffed and covered by a camera. Fast, but everyone will know you came.

routes.name: Service roof
routes.description: A maintenance ladder behind the admin block leads onto the container roofs. Quiet, exposed to the east fence.

routes.name: Blessing's gate
routes.description: A dockworker named Blessing owes Mukoma a favour. He can open the staff entrance and forget he saw you.

routes.name: Drainage channel
routes.description: A storm drain runs under the east fence. Slow, filthy, and almost never watched.

locations.name: Avondale Safehouse
locations.description: A rented cottage behind a lemon tree and a wall of bougainvillea. Nyasha has been sleeping in the back room and working in the kitchen.

routes.name: Front door
routes.description: The obvious way in. The neighbours are used to visitors.

routes.name: Back alley
routes.description: A service lane behind the cottage. Quiet, but the gate is chained.

locations.name: Eastgate and Samora Machel Avenue
locations.description: The commercial spine of the city. Office towers, pavement traders, security guards, and a bureau de change tucked between a pharmacy and a mobile-phone shop.

routes.name: Mall entrance
routes.description: Crowds, cameras, and a security desk that mostly watches the wrong screen.

routes.name: Service corridor
routes.description: A staff corridor behind the food court. Smells of frying oil and cigarette smoke.

routes.name: Roof access
routes.description: A maintenance stairwell leads to the roof. Good for surveillance, bad for a quick exit.

locations.name: Mbare Musika
locations.description: A sprawling market of produce, spare parts, rumours and improvised logistics. Mukoma's garage is three streets away. Everybody sees everything and nobody remembers without a reason.

routes.name: The crowd
routes.description: Disappear into the throng of buyers and porters. Easy, until someone recognises you.

routes.name: Stall roofs
routes.description: Climb across the timber stalls and corrugated roofs. Fast, noisy, and fragile.

routes.name: Rooftops
routes.description: A route across the old warehouse roofs. Slow, but it gives you a clean line of sight.

locations.name: Samora Machel Avenue
locations.description: Four lanes of traffic, kombis, delivery trucks and a railway crossing that is never down for as long as you expect.

routes.name: Main road
routes.description: Straight, fast, and completely exposed.

routes.name: Side streets
routes.description: A maze of one-way streets and loading bays. Slower, but harder to block.

routes.name: Rail crossing
routes.description: A service road beside the railway line. If the barriers come down, the chase ends.

locations.name: Kaguvi Hill Estate
locations.description: A colonial-era estate on a private hill north-east of the city. Msasa trees, a tennis court nobody uses, a helipad, and a security perimeter that is professionally maintained.

routes.name: Main gate
routes.description: A fortified gatehouse with two guards, a boom and a concrete chicane. It is designed to make you feel watched.

routes.name: East service road
routes.description: A maintenance track used by the estate's generator crews. Cameras on the fence line.

routes.name: Hunter's path
routes.description: An old footpath through the msasa trees, known to Mukoma and a few poachers. Slow, steep, and invisible from the house.

routes.name: Press convoy
routes.description: Tariro can attach you to a press convoy covering a protest at the district offices. The guards will hate the cameras, which is the point.

routes.name: Mhofu's keycard
routes.description: Captain Mhofu's keycard opens the service gate and the east stairwell. It only works if he is alive and willing.
